dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Dymond is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the prior home, Dymond was reported to be reactive toward unfamiliar people during walks and when they approached the home or yard and would hard bark and lunge towards them. In the care center, Dymond has displayed kennel fighting when leaving kennel rooms, making it difficult to walk her safely. Dymond is social with staff and loves to work on her skills but is struggling to acclimate. Medically, Dymond is healthy at this time.
dog.name: Dymond
